problem_cards.title: Call
problem_cards.body: The number at the top of this page rings the firm directly — (866) 655-3729. If a case is urgent (someone detained, a hearing this week), call rather than write; calls come first.

problem_cards.title: Send the form
problem_cards.body: The callback form above takes under a minute. Tell us the topic and the best time, and the office calls you back — within one business day, usually sooner.

problem_cards.title: En español
problem_cards.body: Todo el proceso puede llevarse en su idioma — la llamada, la consulta y los documentos. Llame al mismo número o envíe el formulario y le llamamos en español.
